service.method: SELECT SIAD.HOUSE_CODE , SIAD.COMPANY_CODE , SIAD.SMR_NUMBER , SIAD.SMR_STATUS , SIAD.SUBJECT , SIAD.RE_FLAG , SIAD.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE , SIAD.ADD_USER_ID , CASE ${session.LANGUAGE} WHEN 'KO' THEN USMT.USER_NAME_LOC ELSE USMT.USER_NAME_ENG END AS ADD_USER_NAME , USMT.EMAIL FROM SSIAD SIAD LEFT JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SIAD.ADD_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SIPD.HOUSE_CODE , SIPD.COMPANY_CODE , SIPD.SMR_NUMBER , COUNT(REQ_SEAL_CNT) REQ_SEAL_CNT , COUNT(REQ_SEAL_REAL_DOC_CNT) REQ_SEAL_REAL_DOC_CNT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN LAYER = 'REQ_SEAL' THEN 1 END REQ_SEAL_CNT , CASE WHEN LAYER = 'REQ_SEAL_REAL_DOC' THEN 1 END REQ_SEAL_REAL_DOC_CNT , SIPD.HOUSE_CODE, SIPD.COMPANY_CODE, SIPD.SMR_NUMBER, LAYER FROM SFMFI FI JOIN SSIPD SIPD ON FI.HOUSE_CODE = SIPD.HOUSE_CODE AND FI.COMPANY_CODE = SIPD.COMPANY_CODE AND FI.DOC_NUMBER = SIPD.SMR_NUMBER || '_' || SIPD.SMD_NUMBER AND NVL(SIPD.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' WHERE FI.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND FI.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} ) SIPD GROUP BY SIPD.HOUSE_CODE, SIPD.COMPANY_CODE, SIPD.SMR_NUMBER ) RRDOC ON RRDOC.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND RRDOC.COMPANY_CODE = SIAD.COMPANY_CODE AND RRDOC.SMR_NUMBER = SIAD.SMR_NUMBER WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SIAD.APPLY_TYPE IN('C','U') AND NVL(SIAD.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND RRDOC.REQ_SEAL_CNT > RRDOC.REQ_SEAL_REAL_DOC_CNT AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS = 'C' AND ( SIAD.RE_FLAG = 'R' OR SIAD.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE IN ($INS{USE_NUMBER}) ) ORDER BY SIAD.SMR_NUMBER
